h1.en: How Diesel 60 Concrete Pump Separates Pressure from Output
h1.zh: 柴油60型混凝土泵怎样把压力和输送量分成两格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 35 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pressure is a separate cell on the same sheet. The frame titled “Concrete pump” shows Photo showing a concrete pump working a large foundation pour, showing deployed outriggers, rebar mats, and concrete mixer delivering concrete. That frame does not print these two cells, and another maker's plate is not copied onto this model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油60型混凝土泵的理论输送量印成35 m³/h，把最大出口压力印成30 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Concrete pump」的画面主体是Photo showing a 混凝土泵 working a large foundation pour, showing deployed 支腿s, 钢筋 mats, and 混凝土搅拌机 delivering 混凝土。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

body.en: On the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 35 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. A piston pump pushes concrete into the line; a squeeze pump flattens a hose from outside. Either way, m³/h is not MPa. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100. Main Unit Weight 3500 kg.
body.zh: 在柴油60型混凝土泵这一页，理论输送量是35 m³/h，最大出口压力是30 MPa。活塞泵把混凝土推进管路，挤压泵从外面压扁软管。无论哪一种，立方米每小时都不是兆帕。料斗容积 0.4 m³。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100。整机重量 3500 kg。

heading.en: What the frame is allowed to show

body.en: The frame comes from en.wikipedia.org, page “Concrete pump”. Its subject is Photo showing a concrete pump working a large foundation pour, showing deployed outriggers, rebar mats, and concrete mixer delivering concrete. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not treat that caption as a nameplate for the Diesel 60 Concrete Pump. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的页面「Concrete pump」。画面主体是Photo showing a 混凝土泵 working a large foundation pour, showing deployed 支腿s, 钢筋 mats, and 混凝土搅拌机 delivering 混凝土。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油60型混凝土泵的铭牌。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: The Xingtai row does not print a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100. Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Those printed extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 邢台这一行没有印保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。料斗容积 0.4 m³。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100。整机重量 3500 kg。这些已印的附加格仍然不是行程。
